research.why: Nature Nanotechnology work pairing VO2 Mott neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, a neuromorphic spintronic core that keeps temporal spike histories.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature Physics demonstration of two-qubit gates between interacting electron qubits on solid neon, a new scalable qubit platform.
research.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon

research.why: PRL protocol for high-purity spin entanglement through a magnon bus that avoids the usual trade-off between coupling strength and spin decay, relevant to magnon-based quantum links.
research.title: High-Purity Entanglement Mediated by Magnons Despite Weak Coupling

research.why: PRL reports giant room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling in nanocomposite thin films through strain-sensitive polarization, relevant to electric-field control of magnetism.
research.title: Giant Room-Temperature Magnetoelectric Coupling Effect in Nanocomposite Thin Films via Strain-Sensitive Polarization

research.why: Nature news that general-purpose LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) can now design proteins and predict structures, abilities previously limited to specialized tools like AlphaFold.
research.title: Watch out, AlphaFold: Claude and ChatGPT’s new biology skills wow scientists

research.why: PRL demonstration of an orbit-qubit quantum processor in which ultracold atoms in an optical lattice store information in their positions, from the Pan group.
research.title: Orbit-Qubit Quantum Processor of Ultracold Atoms

research.why: PRL theory of odd-parity magnons from topological exciton condensation in the Haldane-Hubbard model, connected to altermagnetism and spin-split collective excitations.
research.title: Odd-Parity Magnons in the Haldane-Hubbard Model from Topological Exciton Condensation

research.why: Nature Machine Intelligence perspective arguing that self-driving labs need reward-function optimization and executable workflows on top of LLM hypothesis generation, relevant to autonomous materials and magnetism experiments.
research.title: Enabling lab autonomy with reward functions and executable workflows
